name: Tvijo RemDesk for Claude Code
documentation_status: Public GitHub Pages guide verified on 2026-11-06; full Claude sign-in remains NOT_RUN.

authentication.access_prerequisite: Service-side approval for the intended account and workspace is required. Plugin installation does not grant access.
authentication.operator_approval_token: Private operator material; never included in this repository or shared with reviewers.

skill_scope: The bundled inspect-project skill guides bounded listing and reading of the project the user explicitly authorized. It does not call filesystem write, command execution, delegation, payment, or root operations.
server_permissions: The service may expose file writes, policy-approved commands, or bounded delegation according to account and host policy. This plugin does not make the connection read-only; inspect the live tool catalog and permissions.
one_liner: Inspect and explain files in a project authorized through Tvijo RemDesk.
description: Tvijo RemDesk for Claude Code connects to the remote HTTP MCP endpoint https://mcp.tvijo.com/mcp and adds a project-inspection skill. The skill helps Claude list a requested authorized directory, read a small relevant set of text files, and explain findings with file references. Service-side account and workspace approval is required. The connection may expose additional tools, including writes, approved command execution, or bounded task delegation when host policy allows; the plugin itself is not an access-control layer and does not make the server read-only. Claude end-to-end OAuth and reviewer access have not been tested for this source release. This plugin is separate from RootRemDesk and does not enable root access or payments.
review_readiness: NOT_SUBMITTED: public protocol checks pass; real Claude consent, reviewer access, and end-to-end tool tests remain NOT_RUN.
privacy_summary: The published notice says authorization, audit, usage, and job records may persist without a fixed automatic deletion period. Erasure requests may remain pending safe writer coordination. Revocation does not erase audit/usage records or data already returned to an AI client; provider and backup copies require separate handling.
copy_sheet_notice: Prepared text for the owner. Not an Anthropic or Claude portal import format, approval, or live listing.
